purpose: live interface validation of the four-role B2 pipeline before any registered-30 B2 or ablation run

selection_rule.description: Outside every B0/B1 registered or interface sample, select the first normalized development item in source order for five-step arithmetic, table_sum, and comparison strata.
notes: Gold programs are used only to identify interface strata and are never placed in live prompts.
No item from the registered30 comparison set or prior interface gates is used.
No sample may be substituted after registration.
Answer accuracy is observed but is not an interface acceptance criterion.
